name: wildcard match by backtracking
mechanism: match a pattern with single- and multi-character wildcards against a string by trying the shortest expansion of each multi-wildcard and backing up to try longer ones on failure

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Rich Salz' wildmat' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Substrings: a widely used open-source recursive algorithm
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Krauss matching wildcards algorithm': an open-source non-recursive algorithm

fails_when: many multi-wildcards give exponential backtracking (the non-recursive variant bounds this)
